::: {#exm-deviance-drop-distribution}

#### Testing the treatment effect

For the statistic of @exm-deviance-drop, the p-value comes from the chi-square distribution with $q = 1$ degree of freedom.

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
# upper tail of the chi-square distribution with 1 degree of freedom
wf_g2_p <- pchisq(wf_g2, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
wf_g2_p
```

The p-value is $`r round(wf_g2_p, 2)`$,
so six patients give no evidence of a treatment effect.

:::
